'''John Trent Jawa Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[John Trent]]
* '''Published:''' August 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jawa Camp|Premiere-D-tatooinejawacamp.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jawa Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Jawa Deck Trent DS 1997 Designs.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I made this deck because I love Jawas. I suggest you don't use this in a tournament because you will probobly lose. I hope you like it.

== Strategy ==

You should get Jawas and Jawa Blasters in your hand on yor first turn, and every turn deploy as many Jawas as you can. Use the Executor and Devastator to crush rebel forces and block force drains in space. The Jawas can battle on Tatooine and can transport to different sites through docking bays or by starships. Deploy the Ion Cannons and Tractor Beams on the Executor and Devastator to iononize rebel ships and capture them. Hopefully you will be able to withstand force drains in space and deplete rebel forces.
